```{r}
# SERVER


server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  
 
  # PREPARE DATA
  
  
  collars <- read.csv("Collar data(Sheet1).csv",
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  
  collars <- collars %>%  
  mutate(
    Date.Deployed = dmy(trimws(as.character(Date.Deployed)), quiet = TRUE),
    Date.Deactivated = dmy(trimws(as.character(Date.Deactivated)), quiet = TRUE),
    
    GPS.Y = as.numeric(as.character(GPS.Y)),
    GPS.X = as.numeric(as.character(GPS.X)),
    
    Last.Fix.X = as.numeric(as.character(Last.Fix.X)),
    Last.Fix.Y = as.numeric(as.character(Last.Fix.Y))
  )
  
  

  # PAGE 1
  # PARK SEARCH

  
  dashboard_data <- reactive({
    
    if (
      is.null(input$park_search) ||
      input$park_search == "All Parks"
    ) {
      
      collars
      
    } else {
      
      collars %>%
        filter(
          Parks == input$park_search
        )
      
    }
    
  })
  
  
  # TOTAL COLLARS

  
  output$total <- renderValueBox({
    
    valueBox(
      
      value = nrow(
        dashboard_data()
      ),
      
      subtitle = "Total Collars",
      
      icon = icon("paw"),
      
      color = "green"
      
    )
    
  })
  
  
 
  # ACTIVE COLLARS
 
  
  output$active <- renderValueBox({
    
    valueBox(
      
      value = sum(
        dashboard_data()$State == "Active",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      
      subtitle = "Active Collars",
      
      icon = icon("check"),
      
      color = "blue"
      
    )
    
  })
  
  
  
  # INACTIVE COLLARS
  
  
  output$inactive <- renderValueBox({
    
    valueBox(
      
      value = sum(
        dashboard_data()$State == "Deactivated",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      
      subtitle = "Inactive Collars",
      
      icon = icon("times"),
      
      color = "red"
      
    )
    
  })
  
  
 
  # REDEPLOYED COLLARS
  
  
  output$redeployed <- renderValueBox({
    
    valueBox(
      
      value = sum(
        dashboard_data()$State == "Redeployed",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      
      subtitle = "Redeployed Collars",
      
      icon = icon("refresh"),
      
      color = "yellow"
      
    )
    
  })
  
  
 
  # YEARLY ACTIVITY
  
  
  output$yearly_activity <- renderPlot({
    
    yearly_data <- dashboard_data() %>%
      
      filter(
        !is.na(Date.Deployed)
      ) %>%
      
      mutate(
        
        Year =
          year(Date.Deployed)
        
      ) %>%
      
      group_by(
        Year,
        State
      ) %>%
      
      summarise(
        Number = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    
    ggplot(
      yearly_data,
      aes(
        x = Year,
        y = Number,
        fill = State
      )
    ) +
      
      geom_col(
        position = "dodge"
      ) +
      
      labs(
        title = "Collar Activity Per Year",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Number of Collars",
        fill = "Status"
      ) +
      
      theme_minimal() +
      
      theme(
        axis.text.x =
          element_text(
            angle = 45,
            hjust = 1
          )
      )
    
  })
  
  # PAGE 2
  # INTERACTIVE TABLE
  
  
  output$table <- renderDT({
    
    datatable(
      
      dashboard_data(),
      
      filter = "top",
      
      extensions = "Buttons",
      
      options = list(
        
        pageLength = 15,
        
        scrollX = TRUE,
        
        dom = "Bfrtip",
        
        buttons = c(
          "copy",
          "csv",
          "excel",
          "print"
        )
        
      )
      
    )
    
  })
  
 # ==============================
# PAGE 3 - COLLAR ACTIVITY
# ==============================


# =========================================================
# UPDATE PARK DROPDOWN
# =========================================================

observe({

  park_list <- sort(
    unique(
      na.omit(collars$Parks)
    )
  )

  updateSelectizeInput(
    session,
    "activity_park",
    choices = c(
      "All Parks",
      park_list
    ),
    selected = "All Parks"
  )

})


# =========================================================
# UPDATE SPECIES DROPDOWN
# =========================================================

observe({

  species_list <- sort(
    unique(
      na.omit(collars$Species)
    )
  )

  updateSelectizeInput(
    session,
    "activity_species",
    choices = c(
      "All Species",
      species_list
    ),
    selected = "All Species"
  )

})


# =========================================================
# FILTER COLLAR DATA
# =========================================================

activity_data <- reactive({

  req(input$activity_dates)

  data <- collars %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(Date.Deployed),
      Date.Deployed <= input$activity_dates[2]
    )


  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # PARK FILTER
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    !is.null(input$activity_park) &&
    input$activity_park != "All Parks"
  ) {

    data <- data %>%
      filter(
        Parks == input$activity_park
      )

  }


  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # SPECIES FILTER
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    !is.null(input$activity_species) &&
    input$activity_species != "All Species"
  ) {

    data <- data %>%
      filter(
        Species == input$activity_species
      )

  }


  data

})


# =========================================================
# NEWLY DEPLOYED COLLARS
# =========================================================

newly_deployed <- reactive({

  req(input$activity_dates)

  activity_data() %>%

    filter(

      Date.Deployed >= input$activity_dates[1],

      Date.Deployed <= input$activity_dates[2]

    )

})


# =========================================================
# RECORDED DEPLOYMENTS OVERLAPPING SELECTED PERIOD
# =========================================================

active_during_period <- reactive({

  req(input$activity_dates)

  activity_data() %>%

    filter(

      Date.Deployed <= input$activity_dates[2],

      is.na(Date.Deactivated) |
        Date.Deactivated >= input$activity_dates[1]

    )

})


# =========================================================
# COLLARS DEPLOYED WITHIN SELECTED PERIOD
# =========================================================

deployed_within_period <- reactive({

  req(input$activity_dates)

  activity_data() %>%

    filter(

      Date.Deployed >= input$activity_dates[1],

      Date.Deployed <= input$activity_dates[2]

    ) %>%

    mutate(

      Status = ifelse(

        is.na(Date.Deactivated),

        "End date unknown",

        "Deactivated date recorded"

      )

    )

})


# =========================================================
# COLLARS OVERLAPPING SELECTED PERIOD
# =========================================================

overlapping_period <- reactive({

  req(input$activity_dates)

  activity_data() %>%

    filter(

      Date.Deployed <= input$activity_dates[2],

      is.na(Date.Deactivated) |
        Date.Deactivated >= input$activity_dates[1]

    ) %>%

    mutate(

      Status = ifelse(

        is.na(Date.Deactivated),

        "End date unknown",

        "Overlaps selected period"

      )

    )

})


# =========================================================
# COLLARS WITH UNKNOWN END DATE
# =========================================================

unknown_end_date <- reactive({

  req(input$activity_dates)

  activity_data() %>%

    filter(

      Date.Deployed <= input$activity_dates[2],

      is.na(Date.Deactivated)

    ) %>%

    mutate(

      Status = "End date unknown"

    )

})


# =========================================================
# VALUE BOX - NEWLY DEPLOYED
# =========================================================

output$activity_new <- renderValueBox({

  valueBox(

    value = nrow(
      newly_deployed()
    ),

    subtitle = "Newly Deployed During Period",

    icon = icon("plus"),

    color = "green"

  )

})


# =========================================================
# VALUE BOX - OVERLAPPING
# =========================================================

output$activity_active <- renderValueBox({

  valueBox(

    value = nrow(
      active_during_period()
    ),

    subtitle = "Recorded Deployments Overlapping Period",

    icon = icon("check"),

    color = "blue"

  )

})


# =========================================================
# VALUE BOX - TOTAL
# =========================================================

output$activity_total <- renderValueBox({

  valueBox(

    value = nrow(
      activity_data()
    ),

    subtitle = "Total Recorded Collars",

    icon = icon("paw"),

    color = "yellow"

  )

})


# =========================================================
# COLLAR ACTIVITY SUMMARY
# =========================================================

output$activity_table <- renderDT({

  req(input$activity_dates)

  data <- activity_data()


  validate(

    need(

      nrow(data) > 0,

      "No collar records match the selected filters."

    )

  )


  summary_data <- data %>%

    group_by(
      Species
    ) %>%

    summarise(

      `Newly Deployed` = sum(

        Date.Deployed >= input$activity_dates[1] &

        Date.Deployed <= input$activity_dates[2],

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

      `Recorded Deployments Overlapping Period` = sum(

        Date.Deployed <= input$activity_dates[2] &

        (
          is.na(Date.Deactivated) |
          Date.Deactivated >= input$activity_dates[1]
        ),

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

      `End Date Unknown` = sum(

        Date.Deployed <= input$activity_dates[2] &

        is.na(Date.Deactivated),

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

      `Total Records` = n(),

      .groups = "drop"

    )


  datatable(

    summary_data,

    rownames = FALSE,

    options = list(

      pageLength = 15,

      scrollX = TRUE,

      autoWidth = TRUE

    )

  )

})


# =========================================================
# TABLE 1 - DEPLOYED WITHIN PERIOD
# =========================================================

output$deployed_within_table <- renderDT({

  data <- deployed_within_period() %>%

    select(

      SAT.ID,

      Name.of.individual,

      Species,

      Parks,

      Brand,

      Date.Deployed,
      
      State,
      
      Date.Deactivated,

      Status

    )


  datatable(

    data,

    rownames = FALSE,

    options = list(

      pageLength = 15,

      scrollX = TRUE,

      autoWidth = TRUE

    )

  )

})


# =========================================================
# TABLE 2 - OVERLAPPING PERIOD
# =========================================================

output$overlapping_table <- renderDT({

  data <- overlapping_period() %>%

    select(

      SAT.ID,

      Name.of.individual,

      Species,

      Parks,

      Brand,

      Date.Deployed,
      
      State,

      Date.Deactivated,

      Status

    )


  datatable(

    data,

output$monthly_activity <- renderPlot({

# PAGE 4-Redeployment register

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# DATA FOR COLLARS WITH DEPLOYMENT CODES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

deployment_register_data <- reactive({

  data <- collars %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Deployment.code),
      trimws(Deployment.code) != ""
    )

  # Search
  search_text <- trimws(input$redeployment_search)

  if (!is.null(search_text) &&
      search_text != "") {

    search_lower <- tolower(search_text)

    data <- data %>%
      filter(
        grepl(
          search_lower,
          tolower(as.character(Deployment.code)),
          fixed = TRUE
        ) |

        grepl(
          search_lower,
          tolower(as.character(SAT.ID)),
          fixed = TRUE
        ) |

        grepl(
          search_lower,
          tolower(as.character(Name.of.individual)),
          fixed = TRUE
        ) |

        grepl(
          search_lower,
          tolower(as.character(Species)),
          fixed = TRUE
        ) |

        grepl(
          search_lower,
          tolower(as.character(Parks)),
          fixed = TRUE
        )
      )
  }

  data

})


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# IDENTIFY REDEPLOYED COLLARS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

redeployment_data <- reactive({

  data <- deployment_register_data()

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(data)
  }

  # A collar is considered redeployed when its
  # State is recorded as Redeployed.

  data %>%
    mutate(
      Redeployment.Status = case_when(

        tolower(trimws(as.character(State))) ==
          "redeployed" ~ "Redeployed",

        TRUE ~ "Not Redeployed"

      )
    )

})


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# TOTAL COLLARS WITH DEPLOYMENT CODES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

output$redeployment_total <- renderValueBox({

  data <- deployment_register_data()

  valueBox(
    value = nrow(data),
    subtitle = "Records With Deployment Code",
    icon = icon("tag"),
    color = "blue"
  )

})


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# REDEPLOYED COLLARS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

output$redeployment_redeployed <- renderValueBox({

  data <- redeployment_data() %>%
    filter(
      Redeployment.Status == "Redeployed"
    )

  valueBox(
    value = nrow(data),
    subtitle = "Redeployed Records",
    icon = icon("rotate"),
    color = "green"
  )

})

# NOT REDEPLOYED

output$redeployment_not_redeployed <- renderValueBox({

    )

  )

})


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# SEARCH RESULTS

output$redeployment_results <- renderDT({

  data <- redeployment_data()

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {

    return(
      datatable(
        data.frame(
          Message =
            "No collar matching the search was found."
        ),
        rownames = FALSE
      )
    )

  }

  results <- data %>%
    select(
      Deployment.code,
      SAT.ID,
      Name.of.individual,
      Species,
      Parks,
      Date.Deployed,
      Time.Deployed,
      State,
      Redeployment.Status
    )

  datatable(
    results,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 15,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      autoWidth = TRUE
    )
  )

})

  output$failure_brand_graph <- renderPlot({

  failure_data <- collars %>%
    
    mutate(
      Brand_clean = str_trim(as.character(Brand)),
      Reason_clean = str_to_lower(
        str_trim(as.character(Reason))
      )
    ) %>%
    
    filter(
      !is.na(Brand_clean),
      Brand_clean != "",
      str_detect(
        Reason_clean,
        "collar failure|battery failure|hardware"
      )
    ) %>%
    
    group_by(Brand_clean) %>%
    
    summarise(
      Failures = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    
    arrange(Failures)


  validate(
    need(
      nrow(failure_data) > 0,
      "No collar failure records were found."
    )
  )


  ggplot(
    failure_data,
    aes(
      x = reorder(Brand_clean, Failures),
      y = Failures
    )
  ) +
    
    geom_col() +
    
    coord_flip() +
    
    labs(
      title = "Collar Failure by Brand",
      x = "Collar Brand",
      y = "Number of Failures"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 12
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11)
    )

})
  
  
  
  
  
  # POACHED VS NATURAL MORTALITY
  
  
  output$mortality_graph <- renderPlot({
    
    mortality_data <- collars %>%
      
      filter(
        !is.na(Reason)
      ) %>%
      
      mutate(
        
        Mortality =
          case_when(
            
            str_detect(
              str_to_lower(Reason),
              "poach"
            )
            ~ "Poached",
            
            str_detect(
              str_to_lower(Reason),
              "natural"
            )
            ~ "Natural Mortality",
            
            TRUE
            ~ NA_character_
            
          )
        
      ) %>%
      
      filter(
        !is.na(Mortality)
      ) %>%
      
      count(
        Mortality
      )
    
    
    ggplot(
      
      mortality_data,
      
      aes(
        
        x =
          Mortality,
        
        y =
          n,
        
        fill =
          Mortality
        
      )
      
    ) +
      
      geom_col() +
      
      labs(
        
        title =
          "Poached vs Natural Mortality",
        
        x =
          "Mortality Type",
        
        y =
          "Number of Animals"
        
      ) +
      
      theme_minimal()
    
  })
  
  
 
  # PAGE 8
  # MOVEMENT DATA
 
  
  movement_data <- reactive({
    
    data <- collars %>%
      
      filter(
        
        Park ==
          input$movement_park,
        
        !is.na(Last.Fix.X),
        
        !is.na(Last.Fix.Y)
        
      )
    
    
    if (
      input$movement_species !=
      "All Species"
    ) {
      
      data <- data %>%
        
        filter(
          Species ==
            input$movement_species
        )
      
    }
    
    
    data
    
  })
  
  
  
  # HOME RANGE
  #
  # This is a preliminary visualization based on the
  # available collar fixes.
 
  
  output$home_range <- renderPlot({
    
    data <- movement_data()
    
    
    if (
      nrow(data) == 0
    ) {
      
      plot.new()
      
      text(
        0.5,
        0.5,
        "No movement data available"
      )
      
      return()
      
    }
    
    
    ggplot(
      
      data,
      
      aes(
        
        x =
          Last.Fix.Y,
        
        y =
          Last.Fix.X,
        
        group =
          SAT.ID
        
      )
      
    ) +
      
      geom_point(
        alpha = 0.5
      ) +
      
      geom_path(
        alpha = 0.3
      ) +
      
      labs(
        
        title =
          "Animal Movement / Home Range",
        
        x =
          "Longitude",
        
        y =
          "Latitude"
        
      ) +
      
      theme_minimal()
    
  })
  
  
  
  # SEASONAL MOVEMENT
  
  
  output$seasonal_movement <- renderPlot({
    
    data <- movement_data()
    
    
    if (
      nrow(data) == 0
    ) {
      
      plot.new()
      
      text(
        0.5,
        0.5,
        "No movement data available"
      )
      
      return()
      
    }
    
    
    data <- data %>%
      
      mutate(
        
        Month =
          month(
            Date.Deployed,
            label = TRUE
          )
        
      ) %>%
      
      count(
        Month
      )
    
    
    ggplot(
      
      data,
      
      aes(
        
        x =
          Month,
        
        y =
          n
        
      )
      
    ) +
      
      geom_col() +
      
      labs(
        
        title =
          "Seasonal Movement Activity",
        
        x =
          "Month",
        
        y =
          "Number of Records"
        
      ) +
      
      theme_minimal()
    
  })
  
  
 
  # WILDLIFE-HUMAN CONFLICT MAP
  
  
  output$conflict_map <- renderLeaflet({
    
    data <- movement_data()
    
    
    leaflet() %>%
      
      addTiles() %>%
      
      addCircleMarkers(
        
        data =
          data,
        
        lng =
          ~Last.Fix.Y,
        
        lat =
          ~Last.Fix.X,
        
        radius =
          5,
        
        fillOpacity =
          0.7,
        
        popup =
          ~paste0(
            
            "<b>Species:</b> ",
            Species,
            
            "<br><b>Individual:</b> ",
            Name.of.individual,
            
            "<br><b>Reason:</b> ",
            Reason
            
          )
        
      )
    
  })
  
  
 
  # CONFLICT SUMMARY
  
  
  output$conflict_summary <- renderDT({
    
    data <- movement_data()
    
    
    summary <- data %>%
      
      group_by(
        Species
      ) %>%
      
      summarise(
        
        `Number of Animals` =
          n_distinct(
            Name.of.individual
          ),
        
        `Recorded Deaths` =
          sum(
            !is.na(Reason) &
              str_detect(
                str_to_lower(Reason),
                "poach|natural"
              ),
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
        
        `Movement Records` =
          n(),
        
        .groups =
          "drop"
        
      )
    
    
    datatable(
      
      summary,
      
      options = list(
        pageLength = 10,
        scrollX = TRUE
      )
      
    )
   
  })
  
}
```
